shared_elements: bearded male human figure in profile
head with elaborate headgear (band/fillet or pointed cap)
hair and beard rendered as rows of tight curls/rings
low-relief figure facing left/right in a single plane
justification: Both depict bearded male figures in strict profile with hair and beard built up as regimented rows of curls and with a distinctive head covering, a fairly specific and conventional way of rendering a male head that suggests shared habits of depiction. However, A is a single monumental head filling the field with no interaction shown, while B is a full-length procession of smaller figures in a register carrying a throne-like object with raised hands, so the relationships and arrangement scarcely correspond.
